name: CopyButton
description:
Copies a value and confirms in place: the icon becomes a drawn ✓ for the feedback hold,
or ✕ when the clipboard refuses (R9.2), and a polite announcement says "Copied". The
button keeps its size throughout. Inside an Input's box, give it `className="fa-input-btn"`.
signature: ({ value, label: labelProp, showLabel, variant, size, className, disabled, ...rest }: CopyButtonProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to the container width.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description:
Why the button is disabled (R12.3). Keeps the button focusable (aria-disabled) so the
reason is reachable by hover, focus and screen readers.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Label shown after a failed action. Use onError to explain the failure.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Trailing icon (chevrons, external-link).

props.name: label
props.description: Names what is copied: "Copy IP address". Also its tooltip. Default "Copy".

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: Label shown while the asynchronous action runs. Its width is reserved with the other feedback labels.

props.name: shape
props.description: Circular instead of the control radius (send buttons, avatars-as-buttons).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown in the tooltip, e.g. "mod+k".

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label beside the icon (default: icon only, with the label as its tooltip).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Label shown after a successful action before returning to the resting state.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Tooltip content. Icon-only buttons always get a tooltip (R20.7): this prop overrides
the default, which is the button's aria-label. Pass `false` only when a visible label
sits right next to the button.

props.name: value
props.description: The text to copy, or a function that returns it when pressed.

props.name: variant
props.description: The named visual variant. It is rendered as a data attribute and styled through shared tokens.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.type: React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, import("@base-ui/react").ButtonState> | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.
